subtopics.title: Data-Centric Benchmark Competitions
subtopics.summary: Competitions that evaluate dataset quality by training models on submitted datasets and measuring performance on standardized downstream tasks, such as CLIP model training and language model benchmarks.

subtopics.title: DataPerf and dcbench
subtopics.summary: Standardized data-centric benchmarks from MLCommons and academic research used to assess dataset quality through model performance metrics.

subtopics.title: Downstream Task Evaluation
subtopics.summary: Assessing dataset quality by measuring the performance of models trained on the dataset across multiple downstream tasks rather than intrinsic dataset properties.
